name: Fuel Token Tracker
description: Track weekly petrol subsidy token schedules for multiple bikes.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string, for example from a free MongoDB Atlas cluster (mongodb+srv://...).

APP_USER.description: Username of the first admin account. More users can be added inside the app.

APP_PASSWORD.description: Password of the first admin account (6 or more characters). Used only when the app starts with no users yet.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign login cookies. Generated for you.
